boundary_conditions: du_dxi(1) = reference_shear_stress * layer_thickness / (matrix_modulus / 3 + 3 * fibre_volume_fraction * fibre_modulus * fibre_radius**2 / layer_thickness**2)

parameters.name: reference_shear_stress
parameters.justification: Mean shear stress on a barnacle base plate from the drag of its shell; linear model, so the compliance does not depend on it. xi = z/layer_thickness, primer at 0, surface at 1; effective shear modulus = matrix shear modulus plus guided-cantilever fibre contribution.
